reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Service for Foreign Policy Instruments

title.narrative: Enhancement of trade and investment opportunities for EU businesses in Papua New Guinea (PNG) and other EPA countries in the Pacific

description.narrative: The action aims at developing better access to trade and investment information for businesses operating (or considering to enter the market) in Pacific countries that are parties to the Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) with the EU. At the same time, the action will promote active engagement of those businesses with European businesses mainly through Business to Business (B2B) events. More specifically, this action will help consolidate the outcomes of the first two EU-PNG Business, Trade and Investment Conferences and promote businesses, trade and investment in environmental goods, services and products obtained through the sustainable management of natural capital.
